tweets.text:
Sentient is live on kaito 🚨 

@SentientAGI is pushing the boundaries of what artificial intelligence can do. It aims to build AGI that is aware, adaptive, and deeply integrated with human values

The project rejects superficial intelligence and instead focuses on systems that truly understand and learn

Core features of SentientAGI include: 👇 

• Self modelling capabilities that let it reflect on its own reasoning processes

• Ethical alignment so that decisions match human needs and long term well being

• Adaptive learning enabling continuous improvement from experience

The people behind it are researchers who believe intelligence must be conscious of context

They work in multidisciplinary fashions combining cognitive science, ethics, computer science, and neuroscience

Their goal is not simply automation or narrow task solving

Instead they are trying to create an entity that can:

• Think about what it does and why it does it

• Adjust its goals in dialogue with human partners

• Balance innovation with responsibility

SentientAGI is ambitious. The risks are acknowledged: misalignment, unintended consequences, and misuse are real concerns. The project is committed to transparency and community review

What sets it apart is its insistence on honesty, on learning from mistakes, on asking uncomfortable questions about power and impact

If AGI is coming, it must arrive in a form we can trust and guide
